column3: You lost the Stars.\nWhy should I trust you\nwith Mercury's light?{end_wait}
Jenna and Kraden\nare still their hostages.\nWe need to act together.{end_wait}
I swore to guard\nthis lighthouse.\nI cannot fail again.{end_wait}
Then stand with us.\nWe can still save them.{end_wait}
You're right.\nWe have no time to waste.{page_break}I'll stop Menardi.\nYou face Saturos.{end_wait}
I doubted you, Isaac.\nI was wrong.{end_wait}
I can still reach her.\nDon't follow me.{end_wait}
I know. Keep Saturos\naway from the captives.\nI'll face Menardi.{end_wait}
I won't let her\ntake them without a fight.{end_wait}
The healer has gone.\nNow face me.{end_wait}
